claims: Michael B. Jordan won the Academy Award for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars.
Michael B. Jordan played twin brothers Elijah "Smoke" and Elias "Stack" Moore in Sinners.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.
Michael B. Jordan's 2026 Oscars win marked his first Oscar nomination.
Michael B. Jordan's 2026 Oscars win marked his first Oscar win.
Timothée Chalamet was a Best Actor nominee at the 2026 Oscars for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was a Best Actor nominee at the 2026 Oscars for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was a Best Actor nominee at the 2026 Oscars for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was a Best Actor nominee at the 2026 Oscars for The Secret Agent.
According to News.az, Michael B. Jordan became the sixth Black actor to win the Oscar for Leading Role.
Before the Oscar win, Michael B. Jordan won the top acting award at the SAG Awards on March 1, 2026.
As reported by People.com and NBC News, in his Academy Award acceptance speech Michael B. Jordan thanked director Ryan Coogler.
As reported by People.com and NBC News, in his Academy Award acceptance speech Michael B. Jordan thanked co-stars Wunmi Mosaku and Hailee Steinfeld.
As reported by People.com and NBC News, in his Academy Award acceptance speech Michael B. Jordan paid tribute to previous Black Best Actor winners.
